A species of amaranth; [Barlaria Prionitis Linn] It is a handsome shrub. Kālidāsa describes the plant as कान्तामुखद्युति (cf. [[Ṛs. 6. 18]]). Modern scientists describe it as a lipped flower referring to the form of its petals. कुरवका रवकारणतां ययुः [[
